measurement: Fresh npm tarball; gzip level 9 per response; panel ESM import closure; largest shipped example HTML plus linked CSS/JS, search enabled, fixed 2026-10-18 build date. Host media and optional theme fonts excluded.
headroom: 15% above each 2026-10-27 baseline, rounded up to the next byte. This permits modest reader features and compression variation while requiring review for substantial growth. Future content features do not receive speculative extra allowance. Raising a limit requires a deliberate reviewed edit here; tests never update budgets automatically.
